findings.description: The instance user data embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key. User data is retrievable by principals with instance or metadata access and may be exposed through Terraform state, creating reusable credential leakage and potential AWS account compromise.
The security group permits TCP/22 from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing SSH to arbitrary Internet hosts and enabling broad brute-force and exploitation attack surface.
The EBS volume does not set encrypted = true or a KMS key, so its contents can be stored unencrypted at rest unless account-level defaults happen to override this configuration.
The snapshot is created from an EBS volume not configured for encryption, so the backup can retain disk contents without encryption at rest.
The bucket storing VPC flow logs has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving sensitive network telemetry unencrypted at rest by configuration.
